{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures-animated-series-coming-to-disney-xd-this-summer|text=''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures'' Animated Series Coming to Disney XD This Summer}} places ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' between {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]] respectively. "[[Return of the Kyber Saber]]" takes place twenty-three [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which occurred in [[19 BBY]] according to ''Star Wars: Timelines'', meaning that "Return of the Kyber Saber" and all subsequent episodes in [[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures Season Two|Season Two]] take place in 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]], while any previous episodes take place between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.<noinclude>
